name: Adiri
description:
Once a great seat of power but much diminished by war, the city-state of Adiri remains stubbornly independent. Here, the ancient tradition of champion warfare is still practiced, though it has been confined to largely bloodless public bouts that have become as much social occasions as tests of martial prowess.

The city owes its continued existence to the Iliyanites, a strange sect of outsiders who inexplicably came to its aid during its rapid fall from power, rescuing it from utter destruction. These mysterious, unspeaking folk were much reduced in the fighting, and now, many years on, remain a small, reclusive minority. Even so, their metal-shaping magic is employed by arena champions and their works fill the city's bazaars with one-of-a-kind armaments.

Even as the city's traditions begin to evolve from pugilism into pageantry, those who still remember Adiri's former glory look upon the neighboring lands with hungry eyes…

hooks.name: The Rust
hooks.description: A strange, fast-spreading blight known as "The Rust" begins infecting the metal structures and armaments across the city, turning priceless gear into brittle, flaking rust. The economy is in free fall, the city’s defensive readiness is compromised, and scapegoating threatens to destroy the long peace of Adiri.
hooks.gmNotes:
The pattern of blight should indicate a clear point of origin: the shop of a disreputable blacksmith who has been known to rant against the Iliyanites. Our Heroes should find a secret door in the shop leading down into a hidden chamber, where they find a grim scene.

It seems that for some months the blacksmith has been holding one or more Iliyanites captive, attempting to force out of them the secrets of their ways. What he has managed to learn is a volatile perversion of their gifts, and The Rust is a by-product of that perversion.

The blacksmith himself should wield a terrifying bodysuit of ever-warping, ever-rusting metal with innumerable sharp appendages, and should be a formidable foe.

Should Our Heroes prevail, it's up to you to determine whether there is some antidote for The Rust, or if the city must simply let it run its course and start anew.

Questions to consider:

  • Why couldn't the blacksmith fully gain the Iliyanites' gifts?

  • How will a city built around the creation, use and sale of weaponry respond to losing all of its weapons?

hooks.name: Blood On The Sand
hooks.description: A faction of hardline traditionalists believes Adiri has grown soft on "bloodless pageantry." Rumor has it that they have bribed or blackmailed several arena champions to turn a major public festival into a real bloodbath and assassinate a visiting foreign diplomat during the chaos. If they succeed, Adiri will be forced into an unwanted war. A worried arena coordinator is looking to recruit someone to infiltrate the games as replacement combatants and stop the assassinations from the inside.
hooks.gmNotes:
This can be fairly straight-ahead as written, or you may consider one or more of the following twists:

  • The arena coordinator is in fact a member of the traditionalist faction and Our Heroes are being set up to be framed as foreign interlopers.

  • The "traditionalist movement" is actually a group of agents working for the foreign power, tasked with assassinating its own diplomat, who knows too much about something in that land.

  • The "traditionalist movement" is actually a group of agents working for the foreign power, tasked with assassinating its own diplomat as a pretext for sparking war with Adiri.

hooks.name: The Ghost Ship
hooks.description: A strange, metallic vessel, empty of any crew, crashes into the shores near Adiri (or, if your Adiri is landlocked, it appears in the dunes outside of town in the night). The vessel is evidently of Iliyanite make, and matches descriptions handed down in oral tradition of the vessels that the Iliyanites arrived in generations ago. The unspeaking Iliyanites in the city quickly set up a perimeter, refusing to let anyone get near the wreckage. Curiosity and wonder grips the city, and a wealthy bazaar merchant is offering a hefty sum for any willing to attempt to sneak aboard the vessel and retrieve any logbooks or artifacts.
hooks.gmNotes:
This one is open-ended and invites you to address the question of why the Iliyanites came to the aid of Adiri. Did they come here for that purpose or did they arrive here because they were running from something?

The heist/exploration should bring Our Heroes face-to-face with some fierce Iliyanite warriors and their metalshaping magic.
